kitchenTagline: Something sweet for the morning after.
kitchenImageAlt: Chocolate cake in a mug, fresh from the microwave
directions: In a large mug, whisk together flour, sugar, cocoa powder, baking powder, and salt.
Add milk, oil, and vanilla. Stir until smooth.
Microwave for 60-90 seconds (start with 60 and add time as needed).
Let cool for a minute, then enjoy.

books.title: Garden Spells
books.author: Sarah Addison Allen
books.description: Family, magic, small towns, complicated women, and a garden with a mind of its own. If you're looking for somewhere to go after Midnight, start here.
books.quote: An additional fun read: In The Company of Witches

noteBody: Thank you for making space for a Midnight in the Club. For believing that an ordinary night can be made a little more magical simply because we decide it should be. That there’s still room for candlelight and wishes, for traditions we make up ourselves, for putting our phones down and looking up at the sky, and for doing things simply because they make life feel a little more special.

This all started with an unreasonably specific idea that I couldn’t leave imaginary, and the fact that you let it become a real part of one of your nights means more to me than I know how to express. I hope you keep making ordinary nights feel like something worth remembering - thank you for spending this one with me.
noteSignature: With gratitude, awe, and love - Lumina
